    if pid == 0:
        os.close(master)
        os.dup2(slave, 0)
        os.dup2(slave, 1)

        os.execv('./executable', ['./executable', '--cmd', 'sleep 0.05'])

        time.sleep(0.5)
        os.write(master, key)
        time.sleep(0.3)
        os.kill(pid, 9)
        os.waitpid(pid, 0)
        out = os.read(master, 10240)
        print(f'Key {repr(key)} output len: {len(out)}')
""}
